_comment: NFPA 70E Table 130.5(G) PPE categories + default IEEE 1584-2018 calculation parameters.
_note: ppeCategories is read by ArcFlashEngine (category thresholds) and ArcFlashBoundaryViewCommand (boundary colours); each is used only where it matches the built-in values, otherwise the built-in values stand and the difference is logged. Working distance and bus gap are not taken from this file: the engine uses the IEEE 1584 per-equipment-class Table values, which the former workingDistances / busGapByVoltage lists contradicted.

ppeCategories.description: PPE Category 0 — Arc-rated face shield, safety glasses
PPE Category 2 — Arc-rated suit 8 cal/cm² minimum
PPE Category 3 — Arc-rated suit 25 cal/cm² minimum
PPE Category 4 — Arc-rated suit 40 cal/cm² minimum
DANGER — Exceeds Category 4. Engineering controls required.
